description: A clip refused for lack of free space: run by clip-guard-probe.mjs while MinFreeSpaceMegabytes is above C:'s free space. As viewer2 (download permission, no admin rights), 'Make a clip' on a range bookmark's row of the details page shows the server's refusal as a toast, the user's sentence 'Not enough free space on the server for this clip. Ask your server admin.', and nothing is queued; the bookmark is deleted again.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: a range bookmark 0:50-0:55 of viewer2's
steps.script: const b = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 500000000, EndTicks: 550000000, Note: 'clip-guard-probe ui' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return b.Id;

steps.name: the bookmark's row with its Make a clip button
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'); return !!r && !!r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Make a clip"]'); })()

steps.name: the refusal as a toast: the user's sentence, no drive or numbers
steps.waitFor: [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].some(t => t.textContent === 'Not enough free space on the server for this clip. Ask your server admin.')

steps.name: delete the bookmark again
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.bookmarkId) }); return true;

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
